body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Podspeakers presented its iPod-docking system ''Micropod special edition'' during CES 0207. In connection with a pc or a laptop, it allows you to enjoy HiFi audio sound with a built-in amp.
